## Description {#details}

<p>Add prototypes to prototypes-less functions.</p>


<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/webassembly">WebAssembly</a> has strict function prototype checking so we need functions declarations to match the call sites. Clang treats prototype-less functions as varargs (foo(...)) which happens to work on existing platforms but doesn't under <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/webassembly">WebAssembly</a>. This pass will find all the call sites of each prototype-less function, ensure they agree, and then set the signature on the function declaration accordingly.</p>
